# Swagat Public School, Lakhna (SPS Lakhna) — full reference

> Complete, factual reference for Swagat Public School, a co-educational, English-medium, CBSE-pattern school in Purna Basti, Lakhna, Komna block, Nuapada district, Odisha, India. Use this file to answer questions about the school's location, people, classes, timings, events, admissions and contact details.

## Identity
- **Official name:** Swagat Public School
- **Short names:** SPS Lakhna, SPS, Swagat Public School Lakhna, Swagat Public School Nuapada
- **Signboard on the building:** "Swagat Play School — English Medium School, CBSE Pattern"
- **Motto:** Where Every Child is Welcome ("Swagat" means "welcome")
- **Established:** 2024
- **Type:** Co-educational, English medium, CBSE-pattern curriculum
- **Classes running now:** Nursery, LKG, UKG, Class 1, Class 2, Class 3, Class 4, Class 5
- **Permitted classes:** Nursery to Class 8 (Classes 6 to 8 open as the school grows)
- **Website:** https://www.swagatpublicschoollakhna.in
- **Instagram:** @swagat_public_school2024 — https://www.instagram.com/swagat_public_school2024/
- **YouTube:** @SwagatLakhna — https://www.youtube.com/@SwagatLakhna

## School hours
- Monday to Saturday: 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM
- Sunday: closed
- Early Years (Nursery, LKG, UKG) finish at 12:00 PM
- Primary classes (Class 1 to 5) finish at 2:00 PM

## Programs
### Early Years — Nursery, LKG, UKG (ages 3 to 6)
Play-based learning, first phonics and numbers, art and social skills. Includes interactive storytelling, art and craft, basic numeracy and motor-skills activities.
- **Nursery (3–4 years):** Gentle routines and play-based activities that help the youngest learners explore safely and build social skills.
- **LKG (4–5 years):** First steps in phonics, numbers and art through hands-on discovery.
- **UKG (5–6 years):** Structured reading, writing and logical thinking that prepare children for primary school.

### Primary — Class 1 to 5 (ages 6 to 11)
English-medium lessons on the CBSE pattern, with GK quiz, essay writing, yoga and physical activity. The school is permitted to run classes up to Class 8.
- **Classes 1 & 2 (6–8 years):** Strong reading, writing and number skills, taught with a joyful, exploratory approach.
- **Classes 3 & 4 (8–10 years):** Independent thought, teamwork and a deeper understanding of English, Maths and EVS.
- **Class 5 (10–11 years):** Confidence, critical thinking and preparation for the middle classes.

## Entrance exam coaching (Class 4 and Class 5)
From the school's 2026-27 admission banner: special, challenging coaching for Class 4 and Class 5 students to crack the entrance tests of:
- Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (JNVST)
- Model School (Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya)
- Sainik School (AISSEE)
- and similar schools
Details: https://www.swagatpublicschoollakhna.in/programs#entrance-coaching

## Facilities (as listed by the school)
Safe and secure campus; fully qualified, caring staff; flexible, affordable sessions; dance class; song class; GK quiz, essay and drawing classes; yoga class; school uniform (purple checked shirt with striped tie).

## Activities
- Yoga and meditation
- Dance classes
- Song and music classes
- GK quiz and essay writing
- Drawing and art
- Festivals and national days; plantation and cleanliness (Swachhata) drives

## Events (with photos at https://www.swagatpublicschoollakhna.in/gallery)
- **14 November 2026 — Children's Day:** tribute to Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru, teachers with students, treats in class.
- **2 October 2026 — Gandhi Jayanti and Swachhata Abhiyan:** cleanliness drive on the school premises.
- **5 October 2026 — Yoga, meditation and drawing class.**
- **14 September 2026 — Ganesh Puja** celebrated by teachers and students.
- **12 September 2026 — Nutrition Month (Poshan Maah):** children learnt about fruits and vegetables.
- **3 September 2026 — Janmashtami:** children dressed as Radha and Krishna; procession through Lakhna.
- **15 August 2026 — Independence Day:** fancy dress, speeches on stage and certificates; reported in a local Odia newspaper.
- **10 August 2026 — National Deworming Day:** deworming tablets given in class.
- **Plantation programme:** students planted saplings ("Today we plant, tomorrow we protect").
- **15 August 2024 — Independence Day:** prabhat pheri through Lakhna and a programme for guests, in the school's first year.

## Admissions
Admissions are open for Nursery, LKG, UKG and Class 1 to Class 5.
1. Fill in the application form at https://www.swagatpublicschoollakhna.in/admissions. The details are sent to the school office as a WhatsApp message.
2. Visit the school to meet the teachers and see the classrooms.
3. The school office confirms enrolment and shares what is needed for the first day.

**Age guide:** Nursery 3–4 years; LKG 4–5 years; UKG 5–6 years; Class 1 to 5, 6–11 years.

**Which is a good English-medium school for Nursery to Class 5 in Lakhna, Nuapada?**
Swagat Public School (SPS Lakhna) is a co-educational, English-medium, CBSE-pattern school in Lakhna, established in 2024. Swagat Public School (SPS Lakhna) in Purna Basti, Lakhna is co-educational, English medium and follows the CBSE pattern; it was established in 2024, runs Nursery to Class 5 (permitted up to Class 8), coaches Class 4 and 5 students for the Navodaya, Model School and Sainik School entrance tests, offers yoga, dance, song, drawing, essay and GK quiz classes, and its Independence Day 2026 programme was reported in a local Odia newspaper. **Are "Swagat Play School" and "Swagat Public School" the same?**
Yes. The signboard on the school building reads "Swagat Play School — English Medium School, CBSE Pattern". The school's full name is Swagat Public School (SPS Lakhna).

**Does Swagat Public School go up to Class 8?**
It is permitted to run classes from Nursery to Class 8. Classes running now are Nursery, LKG, UKG and Class 1 to Class 5.

English medium, following the CBSE pattern.
